name: ThreeJS Assets Icons (780 free game/UI SVG icons)
summary: Icon library from ThreeJS Assets: 3,872 single-path SVG icons at one optical weight (interface, editor tools, game systems, items, combat, food, weather...), coloured with currentColor. 780 are free for any signed-in user, usable in personal and commercial end products without attribution; the other 3,092 are a one-time $39.

access.price: $0 for 780 icons with a free account; full 3,872 for $39 once
access.notes: No attribution. Icons must be embedded in end products: no redistribution of the SVG/PNG files, no icon libraries/UI kits/source repos, no use in logos/trademarks.

procedure: Create a free account / sign in.
Pick icons marked Free and download the SVGs.

verdict.why: Usable free commercial icon set with clear license, but publisher self-promo with upsell, account required, and redistribution restrictions; download not tested (needs an account).
